title: Find patients diagnosed with SLE who had laboratory tests between 1990 and
question: Find patients diagnosed with SLE who had laboratory tests between 1990 and 1997 and showed either elevated triglycerides (TG > 250) or abnormal albumin levels (ALB ≤ 3.5 or ALB ≥ 5.5). Among these, return only those whose hemoglobin was within the normal range (10 < HGB < 17). For each matching patient, provide their ID, sex, diagnosis, and the date of the qualifying lab test, sorted by test date in descending order.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    p."XCL_058",
    p."XCL_059",
    p."XCL_064",
    l."XCL_015"
FROM Patient AS p
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS l
    ON p."XCL_058" = l."XCL_014"
WHERE p."XCL_064" = 'SLE'
  AND l."XCL_015" BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND (
        CAST(l."XCL_047" AS REAL) > 250
        OR l."XCL_031" <= 3.5
        OR l."XCL_031" >= 5.5
      )
  AND l."XCL_032" > 10
  AND l."XCL_032" < 17
ORDER BY l."XCL_015" DESC

For each matching patient, provide their ID, sex, diagnosis, and the date of the qualifying lab test, sorted by test date in descending order.
